𝐌𝐌𝐃𝐀, 𝐋𝐆𝐔𝐒 𝐈𝐃𝐄𝐍𝐓𝐈𝐅𝐘 𝐂𝐇𝐀𝐋𝐋𝐄𝐍𝐆𝐄𝐒 𝐀𝐍𝐃 𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐏𝐎𝐒𝐄 𝐒𝐎𝐋𝐔𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍𝐒 𝐎𝐍 𝐃𝐄𝐕𝐄𝐋𝐎𝐏𝐌𝐄𝐍𝐓 𝐏𝐋𝐀𝐍 𝐅𝐎𝐑 𝐌𝐌𝐈𝐓𝐒
 
The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) and representatives from Metro Manila local government units (LGUs) came together in the Joint Technical Working Group Meeting and Workshop on the Development Planning for the Metro Manila Intelligent Transportation System (MMITS).
 
MMDA General Manager and concurrent MMITS Project Director USec. Procopio Lipana said the workshop was a collaborative platform for innovation and shared learning, underscoring that the formulation of the intelligent transportation systems (ITS) development plan will serve as a blueprint for a more connected and future-ready Metro Manila.
 
“It brings together the collective expertise, experiences, and perspectives of all stakeholders—LGUs, JICA experts, and the MMDA—toward a common goal: the creation of an intelligent, data-driven, and people-centered transport system that meets the growing needs of our citizens,” Lipana said in his opening remarks for the workshop held recently at the MMDA Head Office in Pasig City.
 
MMDA, as well as Quezon City and Mandaluyong, presented the current status of their respective ITS Use.
 
The MMDA featured its Mobile Command Center, CCTV and AI-Enhanced Camera, Radio Communication System, Traffic Signal System, Smart Center Platform, and Waze’s Connected Citizens program which adds official MMDA data so drivers can avoid delays and plan better routes.
 
Quezon City highlighted its QCity Bus Program, partnership with https://t.co/6jpmbTSIRt, and Single Ticketing System.
 
Mandaluyong, meanwhile, shared its Road Crash Data System as its first ITS component as well as recalibration, synchronization, and upgrade of existing traffic signalization in key areas around the city.
 
Traffic Management Expert from Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) Expert Team and Team Leader Takeshi Matsunuma explained the project outline as well as the role of the members of the technical working group and the purpose of the workshop. JICA Expert Team ITS Masterplan Development Expert Tetsuya Sato introduced ITS Planning.
 
The workshop with Metro Manila LGUs intended to provide a platform for discussion on ITS, identify and organize major transport and traffic challenges, propose solutions and directions using ITS, define key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure effectiveness, and consolidate ideas for future planning.
 
During the workshop, LGUs identified issues, mainly on traffic signal/traffic control and public transport, and proposed ITS solutions, in their localities.
 
Concerns such as real-time traffic monitoring, limited intermodal connectivity, standardization of traffic devices, implementation of AI traffic control systems, development of pedestrian-centric infrastructure were identified from the workshop.
 
MMDA Traffic Engineering Center Director and MMITS Project Manager Engr. Francisco Pesino, Jr. said that the inputs from the LGUs has a significant contribution to the ongoing development of ITS for Metro Manila.
 
“The perspectives shared in the workshop brought us closer to achieving a more efficient, data driven, and sustainable transport management system that will benefit our citizens,” he said.

The ITS development plan is designed to advance the MMDA’s vision—under the leadership of Chairman Atty. Don Artes—of establishing efficient, commuter-focused, and intelligent transportation systems in Metro Manila which aligns with and reinforces the newly formulated comprehensive traffic management plan.

#mmda #mmits #metromanilaintelligenttransportsystem
